opening: Hello Mr. Ramasamy, good morning. This is [My Name] calling. I hope I'm not catching you at an incredibly busy moment in Coimbatore?
introduction: I am a supply chain consultant, and I specialize in helping multi-division manufacturing companies streamline their procurement and protect their operating margins.
reason_for_contacting: I've been following Roots Industries' impressive expansion from automotive horns into EV-compatible acoustic devices and precision engineering, exporting to over 80 countries.
company_specific_observation: Managing distinct divisions—from high-pressure aluminium die castings to electronic horns—means your teams are navigating highly volatile raw material markets, particularly for copper, aluminium, and steel, across different production lines.
problem_hypothesis: Typically, when founders oversee such diverse global operations, they find that fragmented procurement planning across divisions can lead to inventory imbalances and margin leakage when material prices spike.
discovery_questions: How are your division heads currently coordinating their raw material forecasting to hedge against copper and aluminium price volatility?
With exports reaching over 80 countries, what is the biggest bottleneck your logistics team faces in maintaining real-time visibility for international OEM shipments?
follow_up_questions: If you could unify demand forecasting across both the automotive and industrial cleaning divisions, what impact would that have on your overall inventory holding costs?
How is the transition to EV-compatible components currently affecting your production scheduling and tooling setup times?
value_proposition: We help multi-division manufacturers integrate their supply chain planning and automate demand forecasting. This typically stabilizes operating margins against material volatility and reduces international shipping delays by up to 20% without disrupting your existing ERP setup.
objection_handling: Objection: 'We already have robust ERP systems and ISO/IATF certifications handling our processes.' -> Response: 'That is exactly why I reached out, Mr. Ramasamy. Your IATF 16494 certification shows your commitment to quality. We don't replace your systems; we layer on top of them to automate cross-divisional forecasting, helping your procurement team act proactively rather than reactively to market spikes.'

Objection: 'I am the Chairman; you should speak to our operations or purchasing heads.' -> Response: 'I completely understand, and I certainly plan to. I wanted to share this with you first because protecting group-level operating margins is ultimately a strategic founder-level priority. Would you mind if I mentioned your name when I reach out to your operations head?'
soft_cta: I know you are incredibly busy, so I'm not asking for a long meeting. I was wondering if it would make sense to share a brief, 10-minute overview of how we've helped similar automotive component exporters protect their margins?
next_step_request: Would you be open to a brief call next Thursday at 11:00 AM, or is there a specific member of your leadership team you would prefer I coordinate with?
